candidates.falsification_condition: The claim counts as falsified if sign 821 in Dholavira signboard contexts is shown to carry a different established value, or if the signboard sequence's locative (place-name) element is shown to be carried by other signs, with sign 821 outside it — either result removes the basis the passage itself states for the ‘city’ suggestion. premise_quote.text: I have posited (Wells 2011) that some part of this sign sequence would be the site’s locative (place name).

candidates.proposition: Sign 821, in the Dholavira signboard contexts, has a meaning of ‘city’, either as a determinative or as a word; of the passage's candidate glosses (DED 752 ūr; DED 808 eyil; DED 3568 nakar; DED 4112 pāri), eyil is the best choice, because Dholavira is a walled city made of cut stone.

quotes.text: It is suggested here that sign 821, in the Dholavira signboard contexts, has a meaning of ‘city’, either as a determinative or as a word.

752 Ta. ūr village, town, city. 808 Ta. eyil fortress, wall, fortification, city, town 3568 Ta. nakar house, abode, mansion, temple, palace, town, city. 4112 Ta. pāri temple; town, city, town of an agricultural tract, hermitage;
Any of these is possible. Which of these, if any, are the correct gloss cannot be known, but eyil seems the best choice given the fact that Dholavira is a walled city made of cut stone.

candidates.proposition: Considered and not credited as a candidate about sign 821: the passage's Fuls paragraph, framed as a verification of the 821 ‘city’ reading, whose asserted content concerns sign 861.

quotes.text: One verification of the sign 821 reading as ‘city’ has been pointed out by Andreas Fuls (pers. com. 2011; Figure 6.12). He notes that the sign combination of 861+740 matches the imagery of a cow (740=*ay=’cow’) and the person in front of a structure, which may be a pictographic toponym (861 = city), seem to fit the readings developed so far. This evidence does not bring us any closer to a reading for sign 861, but does reinforce the association of this sign with important places.
